notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Bestial Bloodline, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Bestial Bloodline by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Mind over Matter.
